shared_elements: row of short repeated vertical elements forming a horizontal band
justification: The only real correspondence is a schematic standing human figure with limbs shown frontally (a linear painted/pecked figure in A, a low-relief figure on the upright slab in B) and, very loosely, a horizontal band of repeated vertical strokes in A echoed by the repeated courses/steps in B, which is architectural rather than depicted content. A is a purely linear, outline figure combined with an abstract cross-in-circle sign and a boat-like stroked band, while B shows no comparable symbols at all and presents a single carved standing personage on a slab set before a stepped platform; the manner of depiction and the scene as a whole share nothing distinctive.
